bundle.shortDescription: Local-first filmmaking studio: ideas, story, screenplay and production planning.
bundle.longDescription: OpenFrame Studio is a local-first desktop application for filmmakers covering idea capture, story boards, screenplay writing, breakdown, scheduling and call sheets. Projects stay on your computer.
